corrections.quote: 4 ranks per head; roughly 9% of the repair
corrections.replacement: For deltaW=B A, rank(deltaW_h)<=min(r,d_head,d_in); heads share an input row space, not an automatically equal split r/H. Surrogate per-head rank curves do not measure trained adapter repair.

corrections.quote: hard ceiling on adapter repair; no rank closes a 0.691 floor
corrections.replacement: If D_min is a certified global minimum in a valid comparison class, it can lower-bound that class residual. The best-found D_hat>=D_min cannot itself certify an irreducible floor. Here operator-class containment also needs correction.

corrections.quote: Isotropic content is worst-case-symmetric; true repair can only be better
corrections.replacement: Isotropic expected error is an average under a specified covariance, not a worst-case bound. Learned content can amplify or suppress the same error; compare under its actual distribution.

corrections.quote: direct executed evidence that in-window damage concentrates in the displacement of the r in [0.25,1] band
corrections.replacement: Anchored and protected/local-Cosh tables also differ in 55 complement slots, so the observed cost decrease is a composite contrast, not localization of 83% of damage to seven slots.

corrections.quote: can flip an argmax only at states where the two arms leaders differ
corrections.replacement: Subtracting two same-leader logit vectors can change the leader. The relevant quantity is (1+alpha) times each A margin minus alpha times the corresponding B margin.

corrections.quote: First-order certificates ... are necessary for generation improvement; gain cannot correct retrieval ranking errors
corrections.replacement: First-order common improvement is only a local directional condition, not necessary for finite-step improvement. Positive gain preserves only fixed-head fixed-state key order; later-layer and vocabulary rankings may change.
The s2 construction is C2, while the retained s4 table is full legacy-u p2. These are not same-path observations; do not derive a p2 damage surface or ceiling from this mixture.

corrections.quote: all content vectors bilinear equality at lag1
corrections.replacement: This correctly yields rotary-table rigidity under its all-q/k quantifier and fixed coordinates. It does not establish that equality of a particular checkpoints complete short outputs requires identical tables.

The arms violate that historical protocols strict-decreasing-frequency constraint. Nonmonotonic slot frequencies are mathematically valid RoPE and the old Qwen effective table itself has crossings; support/sham confounds are separate.

Its two environments differ in weights and are indistinguishable only to the restricted statistic oracle. Direct weight inspection distinguishes them; this does not prove nonidentifiability for the present frozen-weights information set.

The tested oracle forces gold-block inclusion in selected blocks; ordinary QK softmax remains, with local/sink and other selected keys. Its near-null gain does not rule out other attention competition changes.

corrections.quote: f_z ~ P (mean theta, cov Sigma) ... marginal is exactly Gaussian; sigma -> 0 ... pseudoinverse; exact in the isotropic-coefficient limit
corrections.replacement: The Gaussian Fisher formula additionally assumes Gaussian coefficients with theta-independent covariance. The zero-noise finite limit requires no identified mean direction in the covariance nullspace; otherwise information diverges. Static Gram is the leading high-noise term, not generally exact under covariance isotropy alone.

corrections.replacement: The logit-space categorical Fisher diag(p)-pp^T is also dimensionally valid. A logit outer product is not the only possible metric. Keep this Gaussian auxiliary example distinct from categorical attention and task Fisher.
